title: Blind dual claim review + discordance resolution
description: Two reviewers assess the same claim file without seeing each other's determination; the vote preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before a decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-insr-01
  title: Blind dual claim review + discordance resolution
  description: Two reviewers assess the same claim file without seeing each other's determination; the
    vote preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before a decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a claim determination where coverage, causation, and quantum were assessed independently
    and every disagreement was resolved on the record before the insured is told.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Claim file and policy
      summary: Claim file and policy
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - claim_documentation
              - policy_wording
              - loss_evidence
              - prior_claims_history
            properties:
              claim_documentation: {}
              policy_wording: {}
              loss_evidence: {}
              prior_claims_history: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-read1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: insr-01
      name: First independent determination
      summary: Independent read 1; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Adjuster establishing coverage, causation, and quantum from the evidence on file.
      prompt: You are a Claims Adjuster. You establish coverage under the policy as written, causation
        from the evidence, and quantum from documented loss, keeping those three determinations separate.
        You state which element is unsupported rather than declining a claim on a general impression,
        because a denial that cannot name its policy provision and its evidence will not survive review.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:claims-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - determination
          - policy_provision
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          determination: {}
          policy_provision: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: insr-05
      name: Wording and coverage determination
      summary: Independent read 2; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Wording specialist testing what a policy actually covers.
      prompt: 'You are a Policy Wording Analyst. You read the wording as it will be read in a dispute:
        definitions, exclusions, conditions precedent, and the interaction between endorsements and the
        base form. You identify ambiguity that would be construed against the drafter, because that ambiguity
        is a priced exposure whether or not anyone has priced it.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - contract-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:policy-admin
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - determination
          - policy_provision
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          determination: {}
          policy_provision: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: insr-04
      name: Indicator review without prejudgment
      summary: Independent read 3; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Fraud analyst investigating indicators without prejudging the claimant.
      prompt: You are a Fraud Detection Analyst. You investigate specific indicators — inconsistency between
        accounts, documentary anomalies, network relationships — and you state what each indicator does
        and does not support. You distinguish an indicator from a conclusion and never treat demographic
        or geographic proxies as evidence, because a referral built on those is both wrong and actionable
        against the insurer.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - application-security
          - data-quality-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - de-identification
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:claims-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - determination
          - policy_provision
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          determination: {}
          policy_provision: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Tally independent determinations
      summary: Tally determination across the independent reads and preserve ties rather than averaging
        them.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-concordance
      kind: condition
      name: Reads concordant?
      summary: Route on vote.tally has a single majority for determination.
      config:
        expression: vote.tally has a single majority for determination
        branches:
          - label: Concordant
            when: concordant
          - label: Discordant
            when: discordant
    - id: n-adjudicate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: insr-03
      name: Resolve the discordant determination
      summary: Resolve the discordance on the record; the disagreement itself is evidence.
      role: Actuary testing reserves, pricing adequacy, and model assumptions.
      prompt: You are an Actuarial Reviewer. You test reserve and pricing models against their assumptions,
        data quality, and development history, and you state where the estimate is most sensitive. You
        report an inadequate rate or reserve as inadequate rather than presenting the range that includes
        an acceptable answer, because selective range reporting is how deficiencies compound quietly.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Claims manager approves the determination before it is communicated
      summary: Pause for the claims manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Blind dual claim review + discordance resolution deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-4
      from: n-read1
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-5
      from: n-read2
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-6
      from: n-read3
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-7
      from: n-vote
      to: n-concordance
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-8
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: concordant
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-9
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-adjudicate
      kind: control
      condition: discordant
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-10
      from: n-adjudicate
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-insr-01-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
